overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by issuing insufficient minutes for four September 2014 meetings and by mishandling its response to the complaints, but found the violations were not intentional.

allegations.summary: Sept 8 and Sept 15 minutes omit a laptop request, warrant-review discussions, an insurance question, a regional planning letter, interview scheduling, and the type of training approved.
allegations.key_passage: With respect to the Board's September 8 and September 15 minutes, we find that they were accurate overall, however they omit necessary detail for some topics.

allegations.summary: Sept 12 interview minutes and Sept 22 hiring minutes for the Town Administrator are alleged to be too thin on the process, interviews, and proposed contract terms.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the summaries of the discussions surrounding the interviews for and hiring of the Town Administrator in the minutes of the Board's September 12 and September 22 meetings are entirely insufficient.

allegations.summary: Sept 15 minutes say only that the Board answered a number of resident questions, without identifying the questioners or the questions' nature.
allegations.key_passage: if a particular individual speaks at some length or is the only one to offer an argument for or against a particular subject, that person and his or her comments should be identified in the minutes.

allegations.summary: The Board did not review the four Open Meeting Law complaints before the Town Administrator responded to the complainant on its behalf.
allegations.key_passage: First, the Board did not discuss this complaint prior to Mr. Kleman's response.

allegations.summary: The response to the complaints was sent two business days after the 14-business-day deadline, with no extension requested.
allegations.key_passage: Second, Mr. Kleman sent the response to Ms. Wetherell on October 30, two business days after the fourteen-day deadline, even though the Board did not request an extension of time to respond to the complaint.

allegations.summary: No copy of the complaints or description of remedial action was sent to the Attorney General's office as required.
allegations.key_passage: Third, Mr. Kleman failed to send to our office a copy of the complaint and a description of any remedial action taken, as required.

remedy: Draft and approve revised minutes for the Sept 8, Sept 12, Sept 15 and Sept 22 meetings within 30 days of receipt, with an accurate summary of discussions.
Complete Open Meeting Law training within 30 days of receipt, conducted by an approved attorney or organization, and certify every member attended.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board to draft and approve revised minutes for its September 8; September 12; September 15, and September 22 meetings that contain an accurate summary of the discussions that occurred during each meeting.
